rationale: The listed tools provide mainframe performance analysis, test-data optimization, debugging and failure management. These are conventional application performance and testing functions, with no AI capability described.
evidence_spans: Strobe is the industry-leading mainframe application performance management and analysis solution for mainframe applications.

File-AID is the backbone to Compuware's Test Data Optimization solution, enabling developers to right-size their test data, select the right data to exercise test conditions and secure it to guard against breaches
XPEDITER is a family of mainframe testing programs by Compuware.

Compuware's mainframe application failure resolution and fault management solution, enables developers to reduce the tedious and time-consuming task of manually cross-referencing pages of recorded application memory information
